question: What lunar period defines the duration for beginning this ritual observance?
premises: The observance begins on the eighth day of the dark fortnight.
It continues until the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight.
The period is specified by these lunar days.
inference: The ritual observance runs from the eighth to the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight.
plain_english: Beginning from the eighth day of the dark fortnight until the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight.
